2609.26419.title: Reliability Theory for AI Control
2609.26419.paper_summary: Reliability theory gives a mature language for layered systems, but its formal tools are not yet standard in frontier AI control. We apply them to Google DeepMind's defenses against rogue deployment. The same control stack can have cubic, quadratic, or linear rare-failure suppression depending on its failure domains. Birnbaum importance identifies which component improvements buy the most nominal reliability, while prevention changes the population on which recovery is demanded. These results give concrete guidance about what to separate, improve, measure, and test.
2609.26419.paper_summary_zh: 可靠性理論為分層系統提供了一種成熟的語言，但其正式工具在前沿人工智慧控制中尚未標準化。<lb/>我們將其應用於Google DeepMind對抗惡意部署的防禦。<lb/>相同的控制堆疊可以根據其失效領域具有立方、二次或線性稀有失效抑制。<lb/>Birnbaum重要性識別哪些組件改進能帶來最多的名義可靠性，而預防則改變了對恢復的需求所依賴的人口。<lb/>這些結果為應該分開、改進、測量和測試的內容提供了具體指導。
